title: Darth Vader
franchise: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
description: Once a Jedi hero before his precipitous fall to the dark side, Anakin Skywalker lost everything and devoted his life to serving the Empire as Darth Vader. When he discovered that the young rebel who destroyed the Death Star was his son, Luke Skywalker, he scoured the galaxy to find him, hoping to turn him to the dark side so that together they could rule the galaxy as father and son.
